name: gitversion-setup
description: GitHub Action for Easy Semantic Versioning with GitVersion. Installs the specific version of GitVersion tool

versionSpec.description: Required version in the form of 6.0.x or exact version like 6.0.0

includePrerelease.description: Include pre-release versions when matching a version

ignoreFailedSources.description: Treat package source failures as warnings.

preferLatestVersion.description: Prefer to download the latest version matching the versionSpec, even if there is a local cached version.
